title: Windows devices not covered by any compliance policy

report.title: {Items.Count} Windows {Plural(Items.Count, 'device is', 'devices are')} not covered by any compliance policy

messages.businessImpact: These devices are judged by no standard at all. Depending on the tenant setting, they are either invisible or actively reported as compliant.
remediation: Widen the compliance assignment, commonly to all devices, and use exclusions for the genuine exceptions.
Check the tenant setting that decides how unassigned devices are treated.
messages.cannotSee: A tenant whose group membership was not read. The coverage is resolved from it, so without it no device is reported as uncovered rather than every device being.
